speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune thrombocytopenia (ITP). The combination of fatigue, pallor, and specifically the presence of non-blanching pinpoint red spots (petechiae) strongly suggests a platelet disorder rather than iron deficiency. I will order a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with a peripheral blood smear to confirm thrombocytopenia and rule out other causes.
